description: Official JMA climate normals (30-year averages, currently 1991-2020) for one station: for each month and the year, precipitation, mean temperature, mean daily max and min temperature, wind, sunshine and, where the station observes snow, snowfall total and mean annual-maximum snow depth. Use for questions like typical late-January snowfall or temperature at a resort. Takes a station name, station_id or block number. Sourced from the Japan Meteorological Agency, climate normals.

prefecture.description: Optional prefecture to disambiguate a station name.

station.description: Station name ("Nozawa Onsen"), station_id ("48-0393") or block number.

name: jma_climate_normals

data_as_of.description: Date the data is current to (ISO)
